scope: Existing licensed ice/snow architecture, separable ice blocks or frozen-ice photogrammetry; optional one specific CC0 organic object for frozen-object and volume identity. This is source feasibility research, not material-module or prototype approval.

bounds.countingMethod: Four partially visible ambientCG sphere previews in one catalog screenshot, plus Wall of ice, Bronze Ray Statue, Lambis Shell, Snow & Ice Photogrammetry Test, Ice Blocks and Ice Castles NY. Loading-only frames were not treated as inspected model quality; the latter two delayed cases were checked through their actual source preview images or a later loaded viewer.

libraryChecks.redistributionBasis: Official license explicitly covers downloadable files and material preview renders and permits including raw files in projects.
libraryChecks.finding: The material query lists Snow014, Snow013, Snow006 and Ice001 through Ice004. The 3D-model/terrain ice query yielded no asset links. Ice003 and Ice004 source pages identify PBR map sets and a procedural creation method, not finished architectural meshes.
libraryChecks.limitation: A licensed surface map can supply surface variation but cannot supply finished block thickness, internal ice volume, architectural topology, underside detail or separable pointer-lift parts. This check does not approve reapplying these maps to the failed geometry.

libraryChecks.license: CC0 1.0 Universal for downloadable models, textures and HDRIs
libraryChecks.finding: The public catalog response checked for ice, snow and frost yielded snow surfaces and winter HDRIs, plus the unrelated Crystalline Iceplant model; no role-matching ice architecture or modular ice-block mesh was found in this bounded check.
libraryChecks.limitation: Poly Haven website example renders and user renders are outside the downloadable-asset CC0 grant; viewed previews are research only and are not deliverable photography. Catalog absence here is not a claim that no such asset exists anywhere.

checkedModels.name: Ice Blocks
checkedModels.author: nedo
checkedModels.licenseVerification: Original uploader page and public model API agree; API says author must be credited and commercial use is allowed. CC license permits raw redistribution and adaptation with attribution, license link and change notice.
checkedModels.visualObservation: A real street scan with irregular white broken ice chunks on dark asphalt and a curb. Chipped edges, thickness and granular frozen surfaces are concrete, rather than ideal boxes. The preview does not show transparent interiors or illuminated architectural blocks.
checkedModels.feasibleRole: Possible source for realistic broken surface-ice debris only, subject to file inspection and fresh material evidence.
checkedModels.pointerLiftStatus: Unverified. No model archive was downloaded; separate objects, closed undersides, connected components and PBR channels were not inspected. A ground scan is not evidence of clean independent liftable blocks.
checkedModels.reasonNotSelected: Street debris identity, baked ground context and unverified hidden geometry cannot directly replace the admitted spatial ice architecture, internal glow or freeze-through object viewing.

checkedModels.name: Wall of ice
checkedModels.author: Lassi Kaukonen
checkedModels.licenseVerification: Original author page and model API agree. Page carries NoAI; this check used human-visible source inspection only and does not authorize generative-AI input, training or dataset use.
checkedModels.visualObservation: Loaded viewer shows a broad natural ice cascade with vertical translucent-looking streaks, accumulated snow and detailed surrounding rock. It is one continuous cliff/ground scan composition with a visibly cropped base.
checkedModels.feasibleRole: Possible natural ice-wall or terrain context, subject to actual-file PBR and optimization checks.
checkedModels.pointerLiftStatus: No independently closed blocks demonstrated; no final archive or topology inspection.
checkedModels.reasonNotSelected: A natural connected ice wall cannot directly provide the specific architectural assembly, separable lift/inner-light behavior or the frozen-object stage. Nearly one million triangles also require meaningful mobile-budget work before any runtime claim.

checkedModels.name: Snow & Ice Photogrammetry Test + Polarized Lens
checkedModels.author: Air Digital
checkedModels.licenseVerification: Original uploader page links CC BY 4.0; public API returns the same license.
checkedModels.visualObservation: Source preview shows a broad dirty frozen ground/road surface with yellow-brown tracks, a drainage edge and large dark meltwater patches. It has complex real surface evidence but no freestanding architectural object.
checkedModels.reasonNotSelected: Ground-plane scan, context contamination, no assembled ice volume or separable block behavior; PBR channel set and hidden surfaces not inspected.

checkedModels.name: Ice Castles NY — Ice Formations
checkedModels.author: Katie Alois
checkedModels.license: CC BY 4.0 asserted by scan uploader
checkedModels.visualObservation: Later loaded viewer shows two irregular sculpted ice formations with thick overhangs, icicles and snow bases. A large pale hole or missing-looking patch interrupts the upper face of the nearer formation; the preview is opaque and irregular rather than a coherent transparent block assembly.
checkedModels.reasonNotSelected: The uploader explicitly scanned hand-sculpted forms at Ice Castles New York; this check did not establish the underlying sculptor's permission in addition to the scan license. No modular closed parts, usable back sides or architectural assembly were demonstrated.

optionalCC0Object.name: Lambis Shell
optionalCC0Object.author: Kuutti Siitonen
optionalCC0Object.visualObservation: Actual source preview has an unmistakable broad lip, curved spines, spiral shoulder and fine ridged brown/cream shell surface; it is a specific organic volume rather than another generic ring.
optionalCC0Object.feasibleRole: Possible distinct frozen-object and later volume silhouette, after fresh final-scene material/identity evidence. It is a natural shell, not an architectural sculpture and does not satisfy the ice-building role.
optionalCC0Object.limitations: No final model downloaded, no topology/point sampling/underside/runtime test. Do not recolor it blue and treat the frozen material or final point volume as approved. Changing it into a new authored architectural sculpture would be a separate direction and production task.

additionalCC0Preview.name: Bronze Ray Statue
additionalCC0Preview.author: Tina
additionalCC0Preview.visualObservation: A mature bronze ray on a wood base, with sweeping fins and a clear animal silhouette; source page says about 2K triangles and provides baked PBR maps.
additionalCC0Preview.reason: A specific animal ornament, not organic architecture or a solution for ice volume. It also introduces base/support separation work that was not inspected.

excludedWithoutAdoption.reason: Source explicitly describes flat low-poly, opaque palette-colored, LLM-generated geometry and forbids redistribution of the file alone or in a model pack. Does not meet the requested mature material role or explicit raw-redistribution license route; no preview needed.

Massive Glacier Valley lists PBR scan maps but Royalty Free NO AI rather than the required explicit raw-redistribution CC0/CC BY path; terrain role also does not provide liftable architectural parts. Not adopted or downloaded.

remainingCoreGap: No existing checked asset simultaneously provides finished ice architecture, convincing transmissive depth/internal light and separable, closed liftable parts.
Source preview quality cannot establish reusable PBR channel completeness, hidden geometry or runtime material quality; final mesh files were deliberately not acquired in this check.
No suitable CC0 architectural sculpture was established; Lambis Shell is only a concrete natural-object option.
The existing rejected material module remains rejected. A new asset name, different silhouette or more complex mesh cannot approve the unresolved flat/plastic core material.
nextAction: Report the concrete gap to the chief. Do not create another LLM-built model/material patch or new candidate from this research. Any later asset acquisition or artist-authored mature module needs explicit scoped work and fresh actual desktop/mobile material and interaction evidence under the existing gates.
previewEvidenceLimitations: Agent-browser source-page screenshots and API-derived source thumbnails were actually viewed in the tool session. Screenshots remain in the browser temporary directory, not in the project QA evidence tree; this report is not a signed visual review receipt or quality-gate evidence. No reference-site proprietary model, font, screenshot or code was acquired.
